```{python}
#| context: setup
import polars as pl
from plotnine import *
from shiny import render, reactive, ui as core_ui
from shiny.express import input, ui
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Read data
us_counties = pl.read_parquet("data/us_counties.parquet")
us_states = pl.read_parquet("data/us_states.parquet")

# Prepare state list
state_list = ["All US"] + sorted(us_states["state_name"].to_list())

us_choices = ["Population", "No. of Hospitals", "Below model", "Above model"]

def format_number(x):
    """Format large numbers with K/M suffix"""
    if x >= 1_000_000:
        return f"{x/1_000_000:.1f}M"
    elif x >= 1_000:
        return f"{x/1_000:.1f}K"
    else:
        return str(int(x))
```

# State info

## Row {height=20%}

### Column

```{python}
ui.input_select(
    id="state",
    label="Select a State:",
    choices=state_list,
    selected="All US"
)
```

### Column

```{python}
@render.express
def population_box():
    selected = input.state()
    if selected == "All US":
        data = us_states
    else:
        data = us_states.filter(pl.col("state_name") == selected)
    total = data["population"].sum()

    ui.value_box(
        title="Population",
        value=format_number(total),
        showcase=ui.HTML('<i class="bi bi-person"></i>'),
        theme="blue"
    )
```

### Column

```{python}
@render.express
def counties_box():
    selected = input.state()
    if selected == "All US":
        data = us_counties
    else:
        data = us_counties.filter(pl.col("state_name") == selected)

    ui.value_box(
        title="Counties",
        value=str(len(data)),
        showcase=ui.HTML('<i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i>'),
        theme="green"
    )
```

### Column

```{python}
@render.express
def underserved_box():
    selected = input.state()
    if selected == "All US":
        data = us_counties
    else:
        data = us_counties.filter(pl.col("state_name") == selected)
    below = data.filter(pl.col("pred_status") == "below")

    ui.value_box(
        title="Underserved",
        value=str(len(below)),
        showcase=ui.HTML('<i class="bi bi-clipboard2-pulse"></i>'),
        theme="pink"
    )
```

### Column

```{python}
@render.plot
def state_map():
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    # Get selected state data
    selected = input.state()

    if selected == "All US":
        plot_data = us_states
        title = "United States"
    else:
        plot_data = us_counties.filter(pl.col("state_name") == selected)
        title = selected

    # Determine variable to plot
    view = input.view()
    if view == "Population":
        var = "population"
        fill_label = "Population"
    elif view == "No. of Hospitals":
        var = "hospitals"
        fill_label = "Hospitals"
    elif view == "Below model":
        plot_data = plot_data.filter(pl.col("pred_status") == "below")
        var = "hospitals"
        fill_label = "Underserved"
    elif view == "Above model":
        plot_data = plot_data.filter(pl.col("pred_status") == "above")
        var = "hospitals"
        fill_label = "Overserved"
    else:
        var = "hospitals"
        fill_label = "Hospitals"

    # Create simple bar plot (placeholder for map)
    if selected == "All US":
        # State-level view
        p = (
            ggplot(plot_data.to_pandas(), aes(x="state", y=var, fill=var)) +
            geom_col() +
            coord_flip() +
            scale_fill_gradient(low="#deebf7", high="#08519c") +
            labs(title=f"{title} - {fill_label}", x="State", y=fill_label) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(figure_size=(10, 8))
        )
    else:
        # County-level view
        p = (
            ggplot(plot_data.to_pandas(), aes(x="county_name", y=var, fill=var)) +
            geom_col() +
            coord_flip() +
            scale_fill_gradient(low="#deebf7", high="#08519c") +
            labs(title=f"{title} Counties - {fill_label}", x="County", y=fill_label) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(figure_size=(10, 8))
        )

    return p
```
